headline: The U.S. Marine Corps is born
post_facts: First recruits at Tun Tavern, says tradition

scenes.text: [calmly] On this day, in seventeen seventy-five... the United States Marine Corps was born.

scenes.label: Philadelphia
scenes.caption: Sketch of Tun Tavern, Revolutionary era
scenes.text: [thoughtfully] In Philadelphia, Congress called for two battalions of Marines.

scenes.label: battalions of Marines called for by Congress
scenes.text: [calmly] Tradition says the first recruits signed up at Tun Tavern.

scenes.label: Samuel Nicholas
scenes.caption: First leader of the Continental Marines
scenes.title: Their first leader
scenes.text: [thoughtfully] Their first leader was Samuel Nicholas.

scenes.title: A birthday Marines still keep
scenes.text: [softly] Marines everywhere still celebrate this date as their birthday.

scenes.title: Do you know a Marine?
scenes.text: [gently] Do you know a Marine? Wish them a happy birthday.
[warmly] Follow On This Day USA... for a new story from history, every day.
